steps: Attach the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Check the logical machine assignment of the X and A axes
If the axes are already attached to the same machine, confirm the attachment is active
Ensure no other processes are using the axes during the transfer
Use the `detach` command to remove the axes from their current logical machine if necessary
Use the `barrier` command to synchronise the transfer sequence between programs
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the current logical machine attachment of the x' axis
Restart the part program processor
Check the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the configured search hierarchy folders.
Check the part program 'm101.pp' is not overridden by another program with the same name in the search hierarchy.
Verify the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4 (trailing subprogram call).
Add at least three control points between `splineon` and `splineoff` commands.
Check the spline type and ensure control points are evenly spaced for uniform splines.
Verify the `splineon` and `splineoff` blocks are correctly placed in the program.
If the spline type is B-spline, ensure no duplicate control points are used.
Check the program for any `sync` commands that may break the spline prematurely.
Edit the block to ensure only one class 1 preparatory word is present.
Check the G-code documentation to identify class 1 preparatory words.
Verify the block syntax follows the rule of one class 1 preparatory word per block.
Verify the logical device 5 is assigned to only one joint.
Check the Joint logical device parameter for each joint to ensure it is set to the correct logical address.
Restart the system to apply changes.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`
Check the license status to confirm the OPC UA server option is not included
Purchase the OPC UA server option if needed
Verify the OPC UA server is disabled and the alarm is resolved
Restart the system
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
If the system restart does not resolve the issue, restart the drive
If the Master state changed, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system to recover from the emergency state
Check the drive's reported error register for additional details
If the error code is zero, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system
Check the EtherCAT cable connections
Verify the cyclic task configuration for task 1
Check the drive's reported error register
If multiple errors continue, restart the system
Upload firmware to device Drive_3
Start AMCore in device mode
Verify firmware version of Drive_3
Check the fieldbus state is PREOP
If the fieldbus is in operational mode, restart the machine
